name: MCMQR5/R6/R7/R8
tagline: AMD Ryzen desktop series with USB4, dual HDMI and Gigabit LAN
description: MCMQR R5 / R6 / R7 / R8 spans AMD Ryzen 5000 to 8000 platforms. R5 and R7 use DDR4 up to 64 GB; R6 uses DDR5 up to 64 GB, while R8 supports up to 96 GB DDR5. Dual HDMI 2.1, USB4 Type-C, one Gigabit Ethernet port and two M.2 NVMe slots provide desktop connectivity in a PC+ABS enclosure with a 113 x 113 mm footprint.
highlights: DDR4 / DDR5; capacity varies by R model
USB4 + dual HDMI + dual M.2 NVMe
featureHeading: Choose the R platform for your desktop
advantageSummary: Compare processor, graphics and memory by R5 / R6 / R7 / R8, with shared Gigabit networking, display connections and two NVMe storage positions.

features.title: Four platform families
features.description: R5 and R7 offer DDR4 up to 64 GB; R6 offers DDR5 up to 64 GB and R8 up to 96 GB DDR5. Processor and Radeon graphics follow the selected R platform.

features.title: Displays and peripherals
features.description: Two HDMI 2.1 ports and USB4 Type-C with 4K/60 Hz display output connect compatible screens. Five USB 3.2 ports and one Gigabit RJ45 port connect peripherals and the wired network.

features.title: Compact storage expansion
features.description: M.2 2280 and M.2 2242 NVMe PCIe slots provide two storage positions. The PC+ABS enclosure has a 113 x 113 mm footprint and weighs approximately 800 g.

specs.label: Graphics
specs.value: R5 / R7: AMD Radeon Graphics; R6: Radeon 660M (6600H) or 680M (6800H); R8: Radeon 780M

specs.label: Video
specs.value: 2 x HDMI 2.1; 1 x USB4 Type-C with 4K/60 Hz display output

specs.label: Memory
specs.value: R5 / R7: 2 x DDR4 SO-DIMM, 3200 MT/s, up to 64 GB; R6: 2 x DDR5 SO-DIMM, 4800 MT/s (5600 optional), up to 64 GB; R8: 2 x DDR5 SO-DIMM, 4800 MT/s (5600 optional), up to 96 GB

specs.label: Power
specs.value: 19 V / 3.78 A adapter, 100-240 V AC input; 5.5 x 2.5 mm DC jack

specs.label: Storage
specs.value: 1 x M.2 2280 NVMe PCIe; 1 x M.2 2242 NVMe PCIe (up to 2 TB)

specs.label: Expansion
specs.value: M.2 E-key Wi-Fi and Bluetooth 5.2; CPU-integrated TPM 2.0

specs.label: Front I/O
specs.value: Power button; 3.5 mm audio jack; USB4 Type-C; 1 x USB 3.2

specs.label: Rear I/O
specs.value: 5.5 x 2.5 mm DC jack; 2 x HDMI 2.1; 4 x USB 3.2; 1 x 1000 Mbps RJ45

specs.label: BIOS
specs.value: Timed power-on; UEFI diskless boot; automatic boot after power-on

specs.label: Configuration notes
specs.value: CPU, GPU, memory capacity and memory speed depend on the selected R platform and confirmed configuration. Product images are for reference; final I/O follows the confirmed order.
